subject: Request: permission to use Medixa quote + logo for customer highlight
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moreno <elena.moreno@medixa.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: permission to use Medixa quote + logo for customer highlight

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time last week. We loved the outcome of the pilot and the product team is excited to feature Medixa in a short customer highlight on our site and in an upcoming newsletter. Would you be open to granting Redwood permission to: 

- Use the Medixa logo on the customer highlight page
- Publish the short quote below (we'll attribute to Medixa / Elena Moreno)

Proposed quote (feel free to edit):
"Redwood helped us reduce inference cost by 3x while improving response stability — it unlocked new product use cases for our clinicians."

Attached is a quick mockup of the page and a suggested one-paragraph caption. If this is ok, could you confirm that legal is fine with usage and whether you prefer any specific attribution language? If helpful, we can send a short marketing terms doc for signature.

Thanks — appreciate it.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0126

Subject: Re: Request: permission to use Medixa quote + logo for customer highlight

Hi all —

Quick note from legal. We can grant marketing permission but we need the following standard items documented and agreed before distributing externally:

1) Scope: Use limited to Redwood's website (customer highlights / case studies), Redwood-owned email newsletters, and sales collateral distributed directly to prospects. No paid social or paid ads without separate approval.
2) Attribution: Quote to be attributed to Medixa, with Elena Moreno's title included. If the quote is edited for length, the attribution must still be present.
3) Duration: Permission effective for 18 months from the signed date; after that we can re-negotiate.
4) Approvals: Customer must approve the final layout and any edits to the quote prior to publication.
5) Liability: Standard carve-outs (no confidential patient data, no fabrication).

I've attached a one-page draft with the above items (Medixa_marketing_terms_draft.pdf). Two suggested small edits from my side: please change the proposed quote to remove the explicit metric reference unless you can provide a customer-signed attestation for the 3x number; and add a clause that the logo will be used in accordance with Medixa brand guidelines (we will provide a logo pack).

If Redwood accepts those points we can execute a short acknowledgment.

Thanks,
Thomas Reed
General Counsel, Medixa
legal@medixa.com

Attachments: Medixa_marketing_terms_draft.pdf (1-page terms)

Hi Thomas / Elena —

Thanks for the clear feedback and the draft — much appreciated. We agree to the scope, attribution, duration, and approvals language. For the metric in the quote, we can remove the specific "3x" number and use a verified phrase instead. Proposed final quote below (short):

"Redwood helped us significantly lower inference costs while improving response stability, which unlocked new product capabilities for our clinicians."

We also accept the clause that paid social/ads require separate approval. We'll follow Medixa's brand guidelines and share final layouts for approval before publishing.

Could you confirm if a signed one-page acknowledgment (attached) is sufficient, or do you require DocuSign execution? We've attached the signed acknowledgment (Signed_Marketing_Terms_Medixa.pdf) and included a request for the logo pack when you have it.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to spotlight your work.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
